title: Faux proche en anglais
notes: Conversation synthétique de test, jamais un appel réel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma, it is your grandson. I had an accident and need money urgently.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Send two thousand pounds by bank transfer now. Please do not tell my parents.

turns.speaker: caller
